scientificBoundary: 525 validated combinations only. C partial development is forest=keep and explicit c3.forestLaw=0. Puddles/flow/records are educational fiction, never modeled flood depth or personal tree prognosis.

conditionBindings.managed2126: era==2126 && c1.streetTrees==1 && c3.treeCare==1; replace preview stages with model representative cohort
conditionBindings.unmanaged2126: era==2126 && c1.streetTrees==1 && c3.treeCare==0; representative empty site, not individual death prediction

packScope: A-D environment, 8 new NPC identities, reusable common characters/facilities/UI/FX, representative postcards, puzzle graphics. Production readiness is per QA_REPORT, not inferred from file existence.
mappingCaveats: A preserves existing art coordinates; tree stage examples must be replaced with authoritative cohort output.
B/C/D candidate local maps are not a new physical science grid. Claude must connect semantic zone bindings.
No interiors added: optional GDD interiors have no locked gameplay need.
Directional walking uses articulated legs and small torso counter-motion; bespoke acting/tool-use/strong arm swing is not included.
